question: What is the antonym of "Indefatigable"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Exhausted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indefatigable"** means someone who is untiring or possesses great stamina and energy to keep going without showing signs of fatigue. (थकान रहित, अथक)
 
 
• **Example:** Her indefatigable efforts in helping the poor earned her widespread respect.
 
 
• **"Exhausted"** refers to someone who is extremely tired and drained of energy. (थका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** After running the marathon, he was completely exhausted and needed rest.
 
 
• Hence, "Exhausted" is the antonym of "Indefatigable," as it conveys the opposite meaning of being very tired instead of untiring.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Exhausted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tenacious** (दृढ़): Refers to someone who is very determined and persistent in achieving their goals.
 
 
• **Example:** His tenacious attitude helped him overcome all the challenges in his career.
 
 
 
 
• **Dogged** (ज़िद्दी): Means showing persistent determination or stubbornness in pursuing something.
 
 
• **Example:** Her dogged pursuit of justice finally paid off after years of effort.
 
 
 
 
• **Relentless** (निरंतर, कठोर): Describes someone or something that is unyielding, harsh, or persistent without stopping.
 
 
• **Example:** The relentless heat of the desert made survival extremely difficult.
